name: Keeping Pace
summary: Pozzik suspects the Brassbolts brothers have found a new material for their cars. Their designs and run data are unchanged, yet the cars go faster. Rizzle Brassbolts keeps close to his plans, and Zamek can distract him so you can take them. This follows News for Fizzle.

sections.title: Faster Than the Numbers Say
sections.body: The Brassbolts brothers' cars have grown faster, and Pozzik can find only one explanation: a new building material. Their designs and the data from their runs remain unchanged. Rizzle Brassbolts has been absorbed in plans for this discovery almost constantly.

sections.title: A Diversion from Zamek
sections.body: Zamek can distract Rizzle while you take his plans. Pozzik is waiting for them on the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: The Stolen Scroll
sections.body: Rizzle's plans are a scroll of hurried notes and designs. They concern the refining of some raw material.

faq.q: Why does Pozzik want Rizzle's plans?
faq.answer: The Brassbolts brothers' cars run faster, though their designs and run data remain unchanged. Pozzik suspects they found a new building material and wants the plans Rizzle has been absorbed in.
Zamek can distract Rizzle Brassbolts, giving you a chance to take his plans.

faq.q: Who are the plans stolen for?
faq.answer: Pozzik wants the plans. He is on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.
Keeping Pace comes right after News for Fizzle.

faq.q: What follows after securing the plans?
faq.answer: The chain continues with Rizzle's Schematics.
